sentences.text:
High Court Of Chhattisgarh, Bilaspur
 Order Sheet
 In Re : I.A. No. 1/2023
 Cra No. 1478 of 2023
  Harihar @

Shambhu Yadav S/o Kunjbihari Aged About 35 Yea  Caste Mahkul, R/o Puranga, Police Station Bagicha, Distr  Jashpur (Chhattisgarh)
 --
 Versus   State Of Chhattisgarh Through Police Station Bagicha, Di  Jashpur (Chhattisgarh)
 ----

Appellant has preferred this criminal appeal being aggrieved by the impugned judgment of conviction and order of sentence dated 10-7-2023 passed by learned Special Judge, Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocity) Act, 1989 (henceforth 'SCST Act'), in Case No.
58/2021, whereby the appellant has been convicted under Section 450, 376(1), of IPC and sentenced as under :-
Section Jail sentence Fine sentence Default stipulation 450, IPC 7 years RI Rs. 500/-
Additional imprisonment for one month 376(1), IPC Imprisonment for life Rs. 500/-
Additional imprisonment for one month Heard Mr. Awadh Tripathi, learned counsel for the appellant, Mr. Gagan Tiweari, learned Deputy Government for the State and Mr. Sunil Sahu, learned Advocate for the Objector on the instant application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail (I.A. No. 1/2023 ) preferred by appellant Harihar @ Shambhu Yadav.
Learned counsel for the convict/appellant has argued that the appellant is an innocent person and he has been falsely implicated due to previous enmity.

It has been argued that earlier also the appellant was implicated in Crime No. 5/2016 registered in PS Bageecha for offence punishable under Section 376(1), 506 of IPC and 3(2)(v) of the SCST Act but in that case, the appellant has been acquitted by the Special Judge (SCST Act), Jashpur vide judgment dated 29-8-2017 passed in Special Case No. 16/2016.
After acquittal, the complainant again implicated him in the instant case.
The appellant was on bail during trial, hence the I.A. No. 1/2023 be allowed and sentence imposed on the appellant be suspended.
However, Mr. Gagan Tiwari, learned Deputy Government Advocate appearing for the State duly assisted by Mr. Sunil Sahu, Adv. for the complainant opposes the prayer for grant of bail.

We have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the court Harihar @ Shambhu Yadav vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18286700/
1 below.

sentences.text:
Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for both the parties, also considering the evidence available on record, further considering that earlier also the appellant was implicated in Crime No. 5/2016 registered in PS Bageecha for offence punishable under Section 376(1), 506 of IPC and 3(2)(v) of the SCST Act and in that case, the appellant has been acquitted by the Special Judge (SCST Act), Jashpur vide judgment dated 29-8-2017 passed in Special Case No. 16/2016 and thereafter this offence was registered, further considering that the appellant was on bail during trial,
and the appeal may take long time for its conclusion, we deem it appropriate to allow the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail moved on behalf of appellant.
Accordingly, the substantive jail sentence awarded to appellant Harihar @ Shambhu Yadav by the learned trial Court is hereby suspended.
He shall be released on bail on his executing bail bond with surety to the satisfaction of the concerned trial Court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 10-1-2024.

He shall thereafter appear before the concerned trial Court on a date to be given by the Registry of this Court and shall continue to appear there on all such subsequent dates as are given to him by the said Court, interval being not less than 6 months, till final disposal of this appeal.
Consequently, IA No. 1/2023 preferred by appellant Harihar @ Shambhu Yadav is allowed.

It is made clear that the observations made hereinabove are only confined for disposal of aforesaid IA filed in this appeal and it shall not be construed as an expression of opinion of this Court on the merits of the matter.
List this matter for final hearing in due course.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Naresh Kumar Chandravanshi) (Ramesh Sinha)
 Judge Chief Justice Pathak Harihar @ Shambhu Yadav vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 10 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18286700/
